codes.name: No AI
codes.description: A person's own ideas and writing. Spellcheck is allowed.

codes.name: Polished
codes.description: The ideas and the draft were human, but AI did copyedits and redrafting.

codes.name: Proxied
codes.description: The argument, prompts, and outline are human, but most of the writing is done by AI.

codes.name: Informed
codes.description: The thinking was developed with AI through research, brainstorming or debate, but a person wrote every word.

codes.name: Paired
codes.description: A person collaborated with AI on both the ideas and writing.

codes.name: Directed
codes.summary: Some AI ideas, mostly AI writing.
codes.description: Ideas shaped together, with AI writing most text under direction.

codes.name: Borrowed
codes.description: The ideas largely came from AI, and a person wrote them up in their own words.

codes.name: Curated
codes.summary: Mostly AI ideas, some AI writing.
codes.description: AI came up with the ideas and first draft. A person cut and reworked it.

codes.name: Slop
codes.description: Vibe writing. A person provided a minimal prompt and the AI did the rest.
